channel.title: Violations Watch: Bangladesh
channel.description: New incidents reported in Bangladesh. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Police fire tear gas and sound grenades at garment workers protesting for a higher minimum wage in Ashulia and Gazipur; eight workers and labour leaders arrested on 19 Nov, and a journalist seriously injured by a sound grenade (Daily Star, Prothom Alo)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Ashulia, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression, Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Attacks on journalists. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. Reported casualties: 1+ injured. Disputed or caveats: Rumor Scanner found claims that police shot a worker dead to be false. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1290

item.title: A crowd beats a man accused of posting blasphemous content on Facebook as police take him from his home in Feni; he and his wife are then held at the police station (Prothom Alo)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Feni, Chattogram Division, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression, Torture & ill-treatment, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Local crowd (beating); police (detention). Reported casualties: 1-3 injured. Disputed or caveats: Accounts differ on which police officers were injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1291

item.title: A lawyer is beaten by BNP and Chhatra Dal activists at a Dhaka court during a remand hearing, then sent to jail the next day in an anti-terrorism case he says was fabricated (Prothom Alo)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Dhaka, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Torture & ill-treatment, Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: BNP and Chhatra Dal activists (beating); police and court (detention). Reported casualties: 1 injured. Disputed or caveats: Police and prosecution say he admitted involvement in a 9 Nov crude-bomb blast; he denies it. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1292
